lines.text: PokemonXP and the 2026 Worlds event ended Aug 30 at 8pm local; only its Twitch Drop codes remain, through Sep 11
Armored Mewtwo returns in 5-star raids on both days of GO Fest: Mega Finale, Sep 5-6
The GO Battle League: Twilight Trails schedule is out: Mega Editions of all three leagues from Sep 8, then Willpower, Retro and Mega Color cups
The Vibrant Petalweave Collection is in the WoW in-game Shop and on Battle.net

needs_you.action: Finish the August Traveler's Log and spend or freeze Trader's Tender today, before the Trading Post rotates to September
Log in daily to the Time to Aniimo web event before it closes Sep 3 at 23:59 (UTC+8) to earn the launch-day Profile Card Background
Pick Chespin, Fennekin or Froakie in the Mega Ascension Timed Research before Sep 4 at 11:59pm local, since finishing it is what unlocks GO Pass: Mega Finale
Finish the free 10th Anniversary Timed Research for the maxed-stat Mewtwo by 11:59pm local
Rank up GO Pass: Mega Finale before it closes Sep 6, since its Mega Energy is what raises your Kalos partner's Mega Level
Watch 4 hours of WoW on Twitch and claim the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb before Sep 8 at 10:00 a.m. PDT
Rank up GO Pass: August before rank earning stops Sep 8 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points on Sep 5 and 6
Claim your GO Pass: August rewards before they expire Sep 10 at 10am local
Redeem your 2026 Worlds Twitch Drop codes and the SANFRANCISCO2026 tee code before they expire at 20:00 UTC
Use the GO Pass Deluxe: August Lucky Trinket before it expires at 11:59pm local
Buy Midnight at up to 40% off before the Battle.net Game Deals sale ends Sep 13
Pre-order the Advanced ($9.99) or Collector's ($19.99) Edition before the Sep 16 launch if you want the platform-exclusive Fluffy Friend or Doggo Dude accessory
Buy the World of Warcraft BlizzCon Bundle before the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the Battle.net Shop Sep 28
Claim every LEGO Stores reward, including the stamp rally Pikachu and avatar jacket, by 11:59pm local
Rank up GO Pass: September before rank earning stops Oct 6 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points on Oct 3 and 4
Redeem the Chansey Plant code P0K0P1AGARDENS at a Pokemon Center PC before it stops working Oct 7

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The Coiled Isle is open with the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Curse Surges and Cursed Fishing, the Altar of Fangs dungeon, three new Delves, the Tidebound Grotto Lair, Housing Blueprints and four new neighborhood Endeavors.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 is live with the eight-boss Venomous Abyss plus Mythic+, PvP Season 2 and Bountiful Delves; Story Mode and Raid Finder Wing 2 are open, Wing 3 unlocks Sep 1 and Wing 4 Sep 8.

timeline.title: Trading Post: Showdown
timeline.detail: August's western rotation is in its last day, so spend or freeze Tender and fill the Traveler's Log bar for the Ensemble: Midnight Outlaw before the stock changes over.

timeline.title: Northrend Timewalking
timeline.detail: Run Wrath-era dungeons at scaled level for the weekly Timewalking quest and Timewarped Badge rewards before the event closes Sep 1.

timeline.title: Northrend Cup
timeline.detail: Fly Northrend skyriding race courses in Normal, Advanced and Reverse modes through Sep 8 for Riders of Azeroth Badges and cosmetics.

timeline.title: Twitch Drop: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb
timeline.detail: Link Battle.net to Twitch and watch 4 hours of any eligible World of Warcraft stream before Sep 8 at 10:00 a.m. PDT to claim the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb.

timeline.title: Battle.net Game Deals: 40% off Midnight
timeline.detail: Midnight is up to 40% off through Sep 13 on the Battle.net Shop, alongside discounts on select game services.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath flying mount, Ensemble: Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28, when the individual BlizzCon bundles leave the shop.

timeline.title: Vibrant Petalweave Collection
timeline.detail: Four floral transmog ensembles (Sunlit, Blush, Azure, Scarlet) are in the in-game Shop and on Battle.net, sold as a bundle or individually, with the price adjusting for pieces you already own.

timeline.title: Hearthkeeper's Wandering Caravan mount
timeline.detail: A Battle.net Shop ground mount that carries repair and mailbox access with you; Blizzard has not published an end date for the offer.

timeline.title: Trading Post: friendship in September
timeline.detail: September's rotation brings the Crested Ember Leafmimic mount as the Traveler's Log reward, plus special Outlet vendors offering discounted and returning items.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire
timeline.detail: Darkmoon Island reopens Sep 5 for tickets, profession quests, and the monthly carousel and top-hat experience buffs.

timeline.title: Cataclysm Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Cataclysm dungeon rotation returns Sep 15 with its own weekly quest and Timewarped vendor.

timeline.title: Pirates' Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Talk to the Dread Captain in Booty Bay for the one-day pirate costume buff and its achievement.

timeline.title: Brewfest
timeline.detail: Brewfest opens Sep 20 outside Ironforge and Orgrimmar with daily Coren Direbrew runs, Brewfest Prize Tokens, and the ram and kodo mounts.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival
timeline.detail: Honor Uther and Grom at their memorials for the week-long Harvest Festival quest and its bounty of food.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Aug 25 (now): Pet Battle Bonus Event and Northrend Timewalking through Sep 1; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Northrend Cup through Sep 8
Week of Sep 1: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu; Raid Finder Wing 3 opens; September's Trading Post stock arrives
Week of Sep 8: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill; Raid Finder Wing 4 opens; the Twitch Drop window closes Sep 8 at 10:00 a.m. PDT
Week of Sep 15: Cataclysm Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran; Pirates' Day Sep 19 and Brewfest from Sep 20
Week of Sep 22: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Packed House; Harvest Festival through Sep 28
Week of Sep 29: World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deep Six; Brewfest runs through Oct 6
just_past_window: Oct 6-13: Timewalking Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard, as Brewfest ends Oct 6
Oct 13-20: Battleground Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Mega Ascension
timeline.detail: Branching Timed Research has you choose Chespin, Fennekin or Froakie and unlock GO Pass: Mega Finale, with Mega-focused wild spawns and Mega Raids and new Mega Evolution Special Backgrounds on catches, through Sep 4 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: Mega Finale
timeline.detail: The free pass carries enough Mega Energy to Mega Evolve your chosen Kalos partner once; the Deluxe upgrade adds a partner T-shirt, higher Shiny odds and enough Mega Energy to raise its Mega Level, and is only sold through Sep 6.

timeline.title: 10th Anniversary: a maxed-out Mewtwo
timeline.detail: Free Timed Research for every Trainer ends in a Mewtwo with maxed-out stats, a Special Background, and the third Mega Level unlocked for Mega Mewtwo Y; claim it by Sep 6 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: August
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latias encounter with the Lucky Trinket as the final Deluxe reward; Deluxe is $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, GO Points are uncapped Sep 5-6, rank earning ends Sep 8 at 10am local, rewards expire Sep 10 at 10am, and the Trinket expires Sep 13 at 11:59pm.

timeline.title: Twitch Drops: 2026 World Championships
timeline.detail: Codes earned from the Worlds and PokemonXP streams (Great League team-building research, the 2025 champion's Tinkaton with an Elite Charged TM, the Worlds Pikachu) and the SANFRANCISCO2026 tee code all expire Sep 11 at 20:00 UTC.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Participating US LEGO Stores host boosted Pikachu raids, a stamp rally leading to Special Background Pikachu, a LEGO-branded avatar jacket via Timed Research, and a SMART Play demo; everything must be claimed by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale
timeline.detail: The unticketed global finale runs 10am to 6pm local both days with eight rotating habitats (four per day, twice each), Mega Raids that rotate with the habitat, and Mega Mewtwo X in Super Mega Raids Saturday and Mega Mewtwo Y Sunday.

timeline.title: Armored Mewtwo returns
timeline.detail: Armored Mewtwo, last seen in 2020, appears in five-star raids on both days of the Mega Finale; a Shiny one will not be available.

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: The new season starts Sep 8 at 10am local with more Paldea debuts including Maschiff and Mabosstiff, the Mega Evolution debuts of Staraptor and Chandelure, and Dynamax Rhyhorn, Sneasel and Sizzlipede in Max Battles.

timeline.title: GO Battle League: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Ranks reset Sep 8 at 1:00 p.m. PDT and Mega-Evolved Pokemon become eligible in the new Mega Editions of all three leagues; a free Timed Research Pass, Ryme-inspired avatar items and a guaranteed Pikachu Libre rank-up encounter come with the season.

timeline.title: GO Pass: September
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latios encounter; Deluxe is $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, GO Points are uncapped Oct 3-4, rank earning ends Oct 6 at 10am local, rewards expire Oct 8 at 10am, and the Rank 20 Timed Incubator expires Oct 13.

timeline.title: Mega Squads
timeline.detail: Season 24's first event runs Sep 8 at 10am to Sep 14 at 8pm local and continues the Mega Evolution storyline; the featured Pokemon have not been announced yet.

timeline.title: September Community Day Classic
timeline.detail: Season 24's first Community Day is a Classic running 2pm to 5pm local; the featured Pokemon has not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: A Super Mega Raid Day is dated for Sep 19 from 2pm to 5pm local; the featured Mega Pokemon and any ticket have not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Phantump Catch Mastery
timeline.detail: Throw-accuracy Field Research and free Timed Research bring boosted Shiny Phantump with 2x XP and extra Candy for Nice throws or better; $1.99 paid Timed Research adds more Phantump and must be finished by 8pm local that day.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival
timeline.detail: A Harvest Festival event is dated Sep 29 at 10am to Oct 5 at 8pm local; features and bonuses have not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: A Max Battle Day is dated Oct 3 from 2pm to 5pm local, on the same weekend the September GO Pass drops its daily GO Point limit; the featured Dynamax Pokemon has not been announced yet.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local, plus an extra Sunday Spotlight Hour Sep 13; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
No Spotlight Hour the week of Aug 31 during Mega Ascension and the Mega Finale; Raid Hour still runs Wed Sep 2 with Regirock, Regice and Registeel
Max Mondays: Eevee Aug 31, Ralts Sep 7, Rhyhorn Sep 14, Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres Sep 21, Sobble Sep 28
Spotlight Hours: Weedle, Kakuna and Beedrill Sep 10; Houndour and Houndoom Sep 13; a mystery Pokemon Sep 17; Rattata Sep 24
5-star raids: Regirock, Regice and Registeel through Sep 8, plus Armored Mewtwo Sep 5-6; Zacian Sep 9-15; Zamazenta Sep 16-22; Xurkitree, Pheromosa and Buzzwole Sep 23-29; Xerneas Sep 30 - Oct 6
Mega Raids: Gyarados through Sep 8; Beedrill Sep 8-15; Houndoom Sep 11-15; Venusaur Sep 16-22; Malamar Sep 23-29; Victreebel Sep 30 - Oct 6
Shadow Raids on weekends: Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) through Sep 8, then Shadow Thundurus (Incarnate Forme) Sep 9 - Oct 6
GO Battle League: the Mega Edition of all three leagues runs Sep 1-8, and Twilight Trails opens Sep 8 with Mega Editions again through Sep 15, all at 4x Stardust from win rewards
GBL cups after that: Willpower Cup (Great League) Sep 15-22, Retro Cup Sep 22-29, Mega Color Cup Sep 29 - Oct 6
Daily Discoveries: GO Battle Thursday continues in Twilight Trails with up to 4x Stardust from wins and 10 sets a day
Season 24's Community Days are Sep 12 (Classic), Oct 10 and Nov 21
An unannounced Season 24 event is dated Sep 16 at 10am to Sep 22 at 8pm local
just_past_window: Oct 5: Harvest Festival ends at 8pm local
Oct 6: GO Pass: September stops earning ranks at 10am local, with rewards claimable through Oct 8

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: PokemonXP and Worlds Cloud Island
timeline.detail: Grab the mysterious goggles from any Pokemon Center in an area at environment level 3 or above and enter address JW7MXKP2 to tour the Worlds stage island; no end date has been announced.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, code entry) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free and valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the internet Mystery Gift option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now
timeline.detail: Part 1, Bubbly Basin, is live on the eShop and needs the Bleak Beach environment request plus the new Dive move; buying the pass before Aug 31, 2027 also mails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots.

just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 arrives in late 2026 with new accessories, furniture and Pokemon but no new town; Part 3 and its new town follow in 2027

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; launch dates now confirmed by Pawprint

timeline.title: Time to Aniimo pre-launch web event
timeline.detail: Log in daily at aniimo.com/en/jsyz to hatch and swap Aniimo before Sep 3 at 23:59 (UTC+8); use the same email as your first character and a Limited-Edition Profile Card Background is delivered at launch.

timeline.title: Pre-order editions
timeline.detail: The Advanced Edition ($9.99) bundles the Advanced Companion Handbook and the Fluffy Friend accessory; the Collector's Edition ($19.99) adds a Prismana egg, doll and avatar frame, with Doggo Dude exclusive to Xbox pre-orders.

timeline.title: Global launch on PC and consoles
timeline.detail: Aniimo goes free-to-play worldwide Sep 16 on PS5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC; anyone who sealed an Aniimo in the closed beta Bond Pact event reclaims that egg by logging in with the same account and channel.

timeline.title: Mobile launch
timeline.detail: iOS and Android follow a week after the PC and console release, on the same global servers.
